segments.text: I'm starting fake rumors about
streamers. Starting with Jason Lu, who
apparently had an accident in his
underwear this morning.
>> I heard Rakaz been chewing on his
crayons, eating glue.
>> I heard Yano don't know how to sing at
all.
>> I heard Wendy was going crazy last night
because she didn't have her phone for 12
hours and she was hallucinating and
pretending she was on FaceTime.
>> I heard Myth has never kicked a soccer
ball in his life.
>> Sena was the first person to poo in the
port-a-potties. I heard that Lacy was
taking Ozempic in the corner.
>> I saw Sena sneak eight packs of cookies
into her little fanny pack. She's been
munching down in the corner for the last
hour.
>> That is not me, trick.
